bug_fix_verification.original_issue: User reported 'body stream already read' error when deleting clients from UI
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: The fetch response body was being read multiple times without cloning
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Added response.clone() in clientsAPI.delete() to safely read body multiple times
bug_fix_verification.verification_method: Created test client via UI, deleted via UI, verified success message and client removal
